caption: The drawing depicts a statuette of a seated dog-like figure positioned on a rectangular base. The figurine is primarily grayish-white with subtle shading that defines its curly fur texture. There are colored details on the statuette: the ears are accented in yellow and red, the nose and mouth are red, and the eyes are outlined in black. A green and red garland or decorative band is draped across the animal’s front legs near the base, featuring red and green areas with some black spots. The rectangular base that supports the figure is gray with lightly outlined decorative patterns. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or designs.
title: Prince Charles Spaniel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
